description_en: A red fox with golden eyes stands on a wet forest floor. Dark sky without stars. Tree shadows on the ground. Moonlight is faint and diffused.
A red fox walks on a stone path near a misty mountain. Dark sky without stars. Strange moving shadows of trees. Fox has wet fur and determined expression.
A red fox looks at a mirror showing an old man with blue eyes and shadow snake. Forest of mirrors reflects different scenes. Fox has confused and mysterious expression.
